claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a 4-burner gas cooker layout; a central electric/coil-style hotplate is visible, but the report does not show 2 additional gas burners to make 6 gas burners.
Photos show visible flames on the 4 burners, but the report does not confirm oven heating, ignition method, or that every burner works reliably beyond the visible flame.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model/serial or clear wear/usage indicators are provided in the witness report.
The witness report does not include photos or confirmation of the receipt/warranty card.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: The witness report does not show internal components or any evidence about whether parts were opened/serviced.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat properly (thermostat/element/burner issue) even if the top burners show flame.
risks.proof: Video/clip of the oven preheating to a set temperature and maintaining it (or a thermometer reading) plus a short bake test (e.g., heating a tray).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a gas cooker with oven that is unverified for oven working (worst case: oven not reliably working).

risks.risk: Ignition system may be faulty (electric igniter not sparking, or manual ignition issues). Visible flames alone may not prove ignition works every time.
risks.proof: Clip showing ignition from cold for each burner (click/turn to ignite) until flame stabilizes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ignition unverified (worst case: may require manual lighting or has unreliable ignition).

risks.risk: Gas safety features may be missing or not functioning (flame failure device) and there may be leaks/regulator/hose incompatibility.
risks.proof: Photo/close-up of flame-failure system (thermocouple) and a test clip showing burner shuts off when flame is disturbed; also show regulator/hose compatibility details.
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety unverified (worst case: treat as needing inspection for safety/leaks and correct LPG/Natural gas setup).

risks.risk: Condition issues not captured in the witness report (dents, rust, cracks, missing knobs/parts, worn burner caps/grates).
risks.proof: Full set of close-up photos: all knobs, burner caps/grates completeness, oven door glass/handle, and underside/edges for dents/rust/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/parts completeness (worst case: missing/worn parts or damage not shown).

risks.risk: Mismatch in burner count/type (seller says 6 burners; photos suggest 4 gas + central electric/coil hotplate).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the full top surface with labels of each control and what each control activates (gas vs electric).
risks.if_unproven: Price based on what is shown: 4 gas burners plus a central electric/coil hotplate, not 6 gas burners.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the brand/model nameplate (or serial) and the full control panel labels.
Show ignition from cold for each burner (one short clip per burner) and confirm flame stability.
Show oven operation: preheat to a temperature and a short heating test (video).
Provide close-ups of burner caps/grates and confirm none are missing; show all knobs and their condition.
Confirm gas type compatibility (LPG vs natural gas) and show the regulator/hose included (photos).
Show/confirm flame-failure (thermocouple) safety feature and demonstrate it (clip).
Provide photos of the receipt and warranty card.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies a gas cooker with oven and shows a 4-burner gas layout with an additional central electric/coil-style hotplate, but key working-condition and safety details (especially oven and ignition reliability) are not fully proven. Price it at the worst-case within that identified type, and request the missing proof to raise confidence.
